name: Virginia's Beach Lakefront Cabins & Camping
note: Mostly seasonal: about 26 of its ~115 RV sites are sold by the night (a lakefront row, a lake-view row and wooded water/electric sites), alongside lakefront cottages and cabins. Reservations by phone with a credit-card deposit or an email request form, no online booking; 21+ to reserve. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site virginiasbeach.com read 2026-10-21: 2026 rates page sells nightly pull-thru FHU sites S2-9 (30x80 ft) and CF-B..8 (30x60 ft), W/E sites T4/T5 (25-ft trailer max) and T12-18, open May 15-Oct 15, phone 814-922-3261; site map PDF shows 89 seasonal lots vs ~26 nightly RV sites (~23%, passes 1-in-10); seasonal page leases lots by the season, no homes or lots sold; Google Maps 4.3 (314 reviews) at 42.00086,-80.44251 -> real transient RV campground; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: operator rates page says the 'Lake Front' FHU sites S2-9 have 'a buffer area on the lake side, and a 20 ft. bluff between the sites and the beach', and the Lake View CF sites sit higher still with a lake view. Esri satellite at 42.0020,-80.4447 (rendered): S-row pads on open lawn ~20 m back from a shrub-lined bluff edge, Lake Erie ~30 m off, sightline unscreened across the lawn. Bluff-top sites with a climb-down to the beach = lakeview, not lakefront (curation doc bluff/bench rule).
fees_source: https://virginiasbeach.com/campingrates.html read 2026-10-21: 2026 prime season (Jun 5-Sep 7) Sun-Thu $60 for 30-amp W/E sites T4/T5 (25-ft max trailer) and T12-18; Lake View FHU $68/$70, Lake Front FHU $70 Sun-Thu / $75 Fri-Sat; holidays $80; early/late season $2-4 less; rates for 2 adults, children 12 and under free, no resort fee; units 35 ft and up +$5/night.

booking.note: Three-night minimum on holiday weekends. Reservations from Feb 1 by phone (100% deposit) or email request form; walk-ins taken if a site is free.

booking_source: https://virginiasbeach.com/campingrates.html (reservation form text 'Three night minimum on Holiday weekends', read 2026-10-21); https://virginiasbeach.com/sitemap.html (enjoying-your-stay: 'you can always camp without a reservation, if a site is available')
flags: Mostly seasonal (~23% nightly by the 2011 site map; the 2026 rates page lists the same transient site ids)
Sites marketed 'Lake Front' downgraded to lakeview on the operator's own 20-ft bluff statement
No online booking: phone deposit or email request only
